reasons: Cited Section 21.1 matches the preferred position: mutual aggregate cap at the greater of Fees paid or payable in the preceding twelve months and USD 1,000,000.

21.2 provides a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, and 21.3 carves out (uncapped) confidentiality, data-protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement — exactly the required carve-outs — plus confirms Customer's payment of undisputed Fees is not 'damages' subject to the cap.

Resolved 'Fees' definition covers recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, so the cap base is substantive; exclusion of a one-time implementation charge is immaterial given the USD 1,000,000 floor and is properly noted rather than flagged.
Correctly claimed compliant with no redline or comment: rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs and both deterministic checks pass.
Rationale is accurate and cites the playbook position; no one-sided or hidden cap language identified.
